On the last date also, this court observed that if the parties do not appear on the next date of hearing, the matter shall be heard finally.
sh Since the matter relates to Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, e one more opportunity is granted.
ad Let SPC be issued to the petitioner for a date to be fixed by the office.
Pr Let the matter be listed in the week commencing 09/07/2018 for a hy final hearing.
The office is also directed to inquire from the concerned CJM ad whether the petitioner is regularly marking his presence before the M Court.
